mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sim_user WHERE public_id = #{publicId} FOR UPDATE

where.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sim_user_role ur JOIN sim_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.role_code = #{role})

mapper.select: SELECT u.* FROM sim_user u ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM sim_role ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sim_user u WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.email_verified_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sim_user_role ur JOIN sim_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.role_code = 'ADMIN')
mapper.update: UPDATE sim_user SET revision = revision + 1, security_version = security_version + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND revision = #{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT id, permission_code AS code, name, description FROM sim_permission ORDER BY permission_code
SELECT p.permission_code FROM sim_permission p JOIN sim_role_permission rp ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.permission_code
mapper.update: UPDATE sim_role SET revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{roleId} AND revision = #{revision}

UPDATE sim_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, password_updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), email_verified_at = COALESCE(email_verified_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)), security_version = security_version + 1, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND email = #{email} AND security_version = #{securityVersion} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sim_audit_event (actor_user_id, action, resource_type, resource_ref_hash, status) VALUES (#{actorId}, #{action}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceHash}, 'SUCCESS')
